description: Secrets Manager secret value retrieved. May indicate credential theft if the accessing principal is unexpected.
playbook: The secret has been scheduled for deletion (7-day default recovery window -- still restorable via RestoreSecret within that window, not yet gone). This is more aggressive than a simple lockout: every application using this secret will break once deletion completes, and a false positive here has real availability cost. Identify the principal and application that accessed the secret immediately. If this was a known, expected caller, restore the secret before the recovery window closes. If unexpected, let deletion proceed, rotate the secret under a new name, and investigate the caller's session for lateral movement.
